description: R4 (§4.6, §7): view state is presence. Ten pixel gestures and open/close on one connection: no log entry, no `change` event to a `changes` subscriber, the log keeps its length (`final.log_len`); another principal reads the view state with `screen`.
name: r4-input-presence
